cards.example_en: There is no milk left in the fridge.
cards.example_zh: 冰箱里没有牛奶了。

cards.example_en: Nobody answered the classroom phone.
cards.example_zh: 没人接教室的电话。

cards.example_en: She answered with a nod.
cards.example_zh: 她点头作了回答。

cards.example_en: Traffic noise kept me awake until the streets grew quiet.
cards.example_zh: 车辆噪音让我一直醒着，直到街上安静下来。

cards.example_en: None of the answers is correct.
cards.example_zh: 没有一个答案是正确的。

cards.example_en: I ordered a bowl of noodle soup.
cards.example_zh: 我点了一碗面条汤。

cards.example_en: We eat lunch at noon.
cards.example_zh: 我们中午吃午饭。

cards.example_en: He cannot swim, nor can he dive.
cards.example_zh: 他不会游泳，也不会潜水。

cards.example_en: It is normal to feel nervous before an exam.
cards.example_zh: 考试前感到紧张是正常的。

cards.example_en: The windows face the north, so the room stays cool in summer.
cards.example_zh: 窗户朝向北面，所以夏天房间很凉快。

cards.example_en: Cold air made his nose red during the morning run.
cards.example_zh: 晨跑时，冷空气把他的鼻子冻红了。

cards.example_en: I am not ready for the test yet.
cards.example_zh: 我还没有准备好考试。

cards.example_en: I copied the formula into a note and stuck it on my desk.
cards.example_zh: 我把公式抄进笔记，贴在了课桌上。

cards.example_en: Write the new word in your notebook.
cards.example_zh: 把生词写在笔记本上。

cards.example_en: There is nothing in my pocket.
cards.example_zh: 我口袋里什么也没有。

cards.example_en: The notice asks runners to arrive thirty minutes early.
cards.example_zh: 通知要求跑步的人提前三十分钟到达。

cards.example_en: This novel is about a school trip.
cards.example_zh: 这本小说讲的是一次学校旅行。

cards.example_en: We should leave now or we will be late.
cards.example_zh: 我们现在该走了，不然会迟到。

cards.example_en: The number of bikes outside the gate doubles after school.
cards.example_zh: 放学以后，校门外自行车的数目会增加一倍。

cards.example_en: The nurse cleaned the cut and told him to rest.
cards.example_zh: 护士清洗了伤口，让他休息。

cards.example_en: An unusual object washed up on the beach after the storm.
cards.example_zh: 暴风雨过后，一件奇怪的物体被冲上了海滩。

cards.example_en: The ship crossed the ocean in ten days.
cards.example_zh: 船用十天穿过了海洋。

cards.example_en: Class starts at eight o'clock.
cards.example_zh: 八点开始上课。

cards.example_en: This is a map of our town.
cards.example_zh: 这是我们镇子的地图。

cards.example_en: Please turn off the lights.
cards.example_zh: 请把灯关掉。

cards.example_en: The canteen will offer free soup on rainy days.
cards.example_zh: 下雨天食堂会提供免费的汤。

cards.example_en: Mum called from the office to say she would be late.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈从办公室打来电话，说她会晚一点到。

cards.example_en: The officer inspected the tents before the night march began.
cards.example_zh: 夜行军开始前，军官检查了帐篷。

cards.example_en: I often walk to school with my sister.
cards.example_zh: 我经常和妹妹一起步行上学。

cards.example_en: Dad's factory uses oil to heat the workshops in winter.
cards.example_zh: 冬天，爸爸的工厂用石油给车间供暖。

cards.example_en: The rice tastes OK, though it needs a little salt.
cards.example_zh: 米饭的味道还行，不过需要加一点盐。

cards.example_en: My old bicycle still gets me to school on time.
cards.example_zh: 我的旧自行车还能让我按时到校。

cards.example_en: She dreams of winning an Olympic medal in swimming.
cards.example_zh: 她梦想在游泳项目上赢得一枚奥运奖牌。

cards.example_en: The keys are on the kitchen table.
cards.example_zh: 钥匙在厨房桌上。

cards.example_en: I once saw a rainbow after the rain.
cards.example_zh: 我曾经在雨后看到过彩虹。

cards.example_en: Chop one onion for the soup.
cards.example_zh: 切一个洋葱做汤。

cards.example_en: I usually buy my books online.
cards.example_zh: 我通常在网上买书。

cards.example_en: She is the only child in her family.
cards.example_zh: 她是家里唯一的孩子。

cards.example_en: Leave the window open so the kitchen stays cool.
cards.example_zh: 让窗户开着，这样厨房能凉快一些。

cards.example_en: We watched an opera on television.
cards.example_zh: 我们在电视上看了一部歌剧。

cards.example_en: Only trained staff may operate the lab projector.
cards.example_zh: 只有受过培训的人员可以操作实验室的投影仪。

cards.example_en: My opinion is that the later bus is safer after dark.
cards.example_zh: 我的观点是，天黑以后坐晚一点的车更安全。

cards.example_en: The bank is opposite the post office.
cards.example_zh: 银行就在邮局对面。

cards.example_en: Tea or water — which do you prefer?
cards.example_zh: 茶还是水——你更喜欢哪个？

cards.example_en: She peeled an orange at break time.
cards.example_zh: 课间她剥了一个橙子。

cards.example_en: We ordered a bowl of noodles for lunch.
cards.example_zh: 我们午饭点了一碗面条。

cards.example_en: We will organise a school fair next month.
cards.example_zh: 我们下个月将组织一场校园集市。

cards.example_en: Do you have any other questions?
cards.example_zh: 你还有其他问题吗？

cards.example_en: Our classroom is on the second floor.
cards.example_zh: 我们的教室在二楼。

cards.example_en: This football is ours.
cards.example_zh: 这个足球是我们的。

word.example_en: He no longer lives in this street.
word.example_zh: 他不再住在这条街。

word.example_en: Do not make a noise in the reading room.
word.example_zh: 阅览室里不要发出噪音。

word.example_en: We eat lunch at noon.
word.example_zh: 我们中午吃午饭。

word.example_en: Neither the bus nor the taxi has come.
word.example_zh: 公交车和出租车都还没来。

word.example_en: I do not eat sweets any more.
word.example_zh: 我再也不吃糖了。

word.example_en: She can not only sing but also dance.
word.example_zh: 她不但会唱歌，而且会跳舞。

word.example_en: I saw him in the hall just now.
word.example_zh: 我刚才在大厅看见他了。

word.example_en: I cannot talk right now.
word.example_zh: 我此刻不能说话。

word.example_en: From now on, I will read before bed.
word.example_zh: 从现在起，我睡前要读书。

word.example_en: We visit the museum now and then.
word.example_zh: 我们偶尔去博物馆。

word.example_en: A number of parents came to the show.
word.example_zh: 若干位家长来看了演出。

word.example_en: The storm cut off the power.
word.example_zh: 暴风雨切断了电源。

word.example_en: We get off at the next stop.
word.example_zh: 我们下一站下车。

word.example_en: We may put off the picnic if it rains.
word.example_zh: 如果下雨，我们可能推迟野餐。

word.example_en: We set off for the museum at eight.
word.example_zh: 我们八点出发去博物馆。

word.example_en: The flowers give off a sweet smell.
word.example_zh: 这些花发出甜甜的气味。

word.example_en: Go on with your story, please.
word.example_zh: 请接着讲你的故事。

word.example_en: We watched the game on TV.
word.example_zh: 我们在电视上看了比赛。

word.example_en: Get on the bus at the school gate.
word.example_zh: 在校门口上车。

word.example_en: Put on a coat. It is cold.
word.example_zh: 穿上外套，天冷。

word.example_en: Come on, we are almost there.
word.example_zh: 加油，我们快到了。

word.example_en: The bell rang, and we stood up at once.
word.example_zh: 铃响了，我们马上站起来。

word.example_en: Please say the sentence once again.
word.example_zh: 请把这个句子再说一次。

word.example_en: Once upon a time, a cat lived by the river.
word.example_zh: 从前，一只猫住在河边。

word.example_en: We can either walk or ride a bike.
word.example_zh: 我们可以走路，也可以骑车。

word.example_en: The two bags are more or less the same.
word.example_zh: 两个包差不多一样。

word.example_en: I cannot tell whether it is tea or juice.
word.example_zh: 我分不清那是茶还是果汁。

word.example_en: Sooner or later, you will meet a kind teacher.
word.example_zh: 你迟早会遇到一位好老师。

word.example_en: She got up early in order to catch the train.
word.example_zh: 她早起是为了赶上火车。
